Name: White Totoro Rabbit Replacement
Author: Sagis4life
Description:
How to Install the mod:

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Extract the Totoro mod folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods.
4. Run your game through  [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and you're ready to play!

This is my first time creating a mod, I would love some feedback, if you have any suggestions on improvements don't hesitate to contact me! The same goes if you're experiencing any problems with the mod. Have a wonderful gaming experience!
